description: This file defines a `DashboardPage` function component that constructs and returns a DOM element representing the dashboard of a language learning web app. It imports UI components, data fetching functions, and routing helpers, then creates a dashboard with a welcome message, navigation buttons, and recent stats on lessons, vocabulary, and quizzes.

methods.name: DashboardPage()
methods.description: Constructs and returns the DOM element for the dashboard page, including a header, navigation buttons, and statistical cards.
